items.en: Agents on it. IT assets in order.
items.zh:
Agent 主动跟进，
IT 资产井井有条。

items.en: Traditional ITAM tools are ledgers kept by hand. In NocoITAM, agents sort out MDM differences, kit out new hires, and check stock and idle assets before every purchase. Every device, seat, and dollar is on record.
items.zh: 传统资产系统靠人维护台账。在 NocoITAM 里，Agent 整理 MDM 差异、为新人配齐设备、采购前先查库存和闲置。每台设备、每个席位、每笔开支都有据可查。

items.en: You're signed in to a demo account. All the data is made up, so try anything.
items.zh: 已用演示账号自动登录，数据都是虚构的，可以随意操作。

items.en: Open it in full in a new tab

Agents never change records on their own. Every action is proposed by an agent and confirmed by its owner. You see not only how much was saved, but which purchase request or license seat it came from.
items.zh: Agent 绝不擅自改账：每项建议都经负责人确认后才执行。省了多少钱、省在哪张采购单或哪个软件席位上，全都清清楚楚。

items.en: check stock, idle assets, and past prices.
items.zh: 先查库存、闲置与历史价格。

items.en: As soon as a request is submitted, the approval assistant checks whether stock or idle assets can cover it, compares past unit prices and similar requests, flags missing details, and drafts a recommendation and comment.
items.zh: 采购单一提交，审批助手自动算好细账：是否有库存或闲置可用、历史单价多少、同类申请往常怎么批、申请说明是否完整，并直接给出审批建议与批注草稿。

items.en: The approval assistant offers far more than “approve” or “reject.”
items.zh: 审批助手给出的，远不止“同意”或“驳回”。

items.en: “Approve with conditions: 3 matching monitors are in stock, so buy only the remaining 2.”
items.zh: “建议有条件同意：库存已有 3 台同型号显示器可领用，只需采购差额 2 台。”

items.en: “Reject: this printer is only 20 months old with no repair history. Repair before disposing.”
items.zh: “建议驳回：该打印机仅使用 20 个月且无维修记录，建议先报修而非直接报废。”

items.en: “Approve with conditions: none of this model in stock, but 3 alternatives are available. Confirm the budget and new-hire headcount first.”
items.zh: “建议有条件同意：同型号无库存，但在库有 3 台替代机型可用；请先确认本季预算与入职名单。”

items.en: New hires are ready on day one.

items.zh: 离职资产一件不落收回。

items.en: Before day one, NocoITAM matches the new hire’s standard kit against stock and idle seats in a single batch. Confirm it, and draft a PO for any gaps in one click. When someone leaves, it tracks devices, accessories, seats, and off-system tasks like revoking accounts and rotating keys until everything is cleared.
items.zh: 入职前，按岗位标准算好所需设备与软件席位，自动匹配库存与闲置，打包生成配置方案；你只需确认，缺口一键起草采购单。离职时反向核销，设备、配件、席位以及停用账号、轮换密钥等系统外事项逐一追踪，不漏一项。

items.en: discrepancies turn into an action plan.
items.zh: 差异自动整理成处理方案。

items.en: After syncing with Intune or Jamf Pro, the agent sorts discrepancies with context: assignee mismatches go to device owners, unregistered devices go to asset admins, and edge cases like long-offline laptops are flagged for human review. Check and apply in one batch.
items.zh: 与 Intune、Jamf Pro 同步后，Agent 自动归类差异并附上原因：使用人不符的派给设备负责人，未入账的新设备派给资产管理员；失联设备等疑难情况留给人判断。在收件箱勾选确认即可批量执行。
告别每周导出表格手工比对

items.en: Every discrepancy has a clear owner and reason
items.zh: 每处差异都有明确责任人与处理依据

items.en: Every reconciliation is logged in the device history
items.zh: 变更记录自动留存在设备时间线中

items.en: Full lifecycle tracking from stock to disposal, continuously reconciled with Intune and Jamf Pro.
items.zh: 在用、库存、维修、借出、报废全周期流转留痕，并与 Intune、Jamf Pro 持续对账。

items.en: Track quantities issued, returned, and in stock, with alerts below minimum; components go into devices and move with them.
items.zh: 按数量管理领用、归还与库存，低于水位自动提醒；组件可装进设备，随设备一起流转。

items.en: Track subscription and perpetual seats (compliant, idle, or over-allocated), with alerts before auto-renewal.
items.zh: 清晰掌握订阅与永久授权的总席位、已分配、闲置与超量情况，自动续费前提前预警。

items.en: Flags late deliveries, logs repair costs per device, and tracks audit discrepancies to resolution.
items.zh: 全流程闭环：到货逾期自动提醒，维修费用归集到设备，盘点差异逐项跟进。

items.en: Write down your kit standards and approval rules.
items.zh: 写下你们的配置标准与审批规则，

items.en: Define your standard kits, budgets, and approval thresholds in plain text, read by every agent on every run.
items.zh: 用自然语言写明公司概况、岗位标准配置、预算与审批红线，所有 Agent 每次运行都会读取遵循。

items.en: Built-in skills for approval review, catalog, device sync, and onboarding/offboarding are fully readable and customizable.
items.zh: 内置采购审阅、型号建档、MDM 对账、入转离等技能，随时查看或按内部流程修改。

items.en: Assign models per agent and track usage. Need custom fields, workflows, or reports? Have a coding agent modify the source in Studio: open-source, self-hosted, and yours.
items.zh: 按 Agent 指定模型并监控用量。需要改字段、流程或报表？在 Studio 里让 Coding Agent 直接改源码。开源、私有部署，代码归你。

items.en: Less reconciling for IT, a clear view of every asset.
items.zh: IT 少对账，资产始终清楚。

items.en: Try NocoITAM online, or get the source on GitHub and run it yourself. Connect your MDM, import your assets, and let agents start reconciling.
items.zh: 在线体验 NocoITAM，或到 GitHub 获取源码自行部署。连上 MDM、导入资产表，Agent 即刻开始对账。

title.zh: NocoITAM — Agent 主动跟进，IT 资产井井有条
title.en: NocoITAM — Agents on It. IT Assets in Order.

description.zh: NocoITAM 是基于 NocoBase 的开源 IT 资产管理。Agent 替 IT 核对 MDM 与台账、为入职离职备好清单、每笔采购先看库存和闲置、续订前回收闲置席位；IT 只做判断。
description.en: NocoITAM is open-source IT asset management on NocoBase. Agents reconcile MDM with the register, prepare joiner and leaver lists, check stock and idle assets before every purchase, and reclaim idle seats before renewal. IT just decides.
